name: Order Picking App for SureCart
author: Arture B.V.

sections.description:
This plugin connects a SureCart store to Order Picking App using the standard Order Picking App REST contract.

The SureCart edition does not maintain a local mirror of SureCart orders and does not create custom database tables. Orders, checkout line items, products, variants, customers and shipping data are read from SureCart when needed. Order Picking App workflow state that has no direct SureCart equivalent is stored in normal WordPress options.

An active Order Picking App account is required!

External Services

This plugin connects to the Order Picking App service at orderpickingapp.com and to SureCart through the SureCart WordPress plugin/API layer. These connections provide the account, order picking, inventory, reporting and fulfillment features requested by the administrator.

The plugin’s built-in admin images, introduction-video preview, product placeholder and default order-label logo are bundled locally. Viewing the admin pages before connecting an account does not load built-in media or make background service requests to orderpickingapp.com. The introduction video and other external links open only when clicked. No admin-usage tracking or deactivation-feedback collection is included.

When the administrator submits the free-trial form, the entered company, billing/address and email details, the store URL and the platform name are sent to Order Picking App to create the requested account. Saving an API key connects an existing account. Once connected, authenticated requests exchange account settings, app-user settings, the store URL, order/product identifiers, inventory history and picking reports. The token-authenticated store endpoints also provide the store, order, product, customer and picking data needed by the connected service. Account creation is an explicit administrator action; other background Order Picking App service requests require a configured API key.

SureCart requests use the installed SureCart plugin’s configured API connection to read orders, checkout line items, products, variants, customers, collections and shipping data, and to perform requested catalog, checkout, order-note and fulfillment updates. If the administrator enables a custom order-label logo URL, that chosen image is fetched when generating the label and loaded in its preview.

Order Picking App:
* Website: https://orderpickingapp.com
* Terms: https://orderpickingapp.com/terms-and-conditions/
* Privacy: https://orderpickingapp.com/privacy

The token-authenticated REST endpoints exposed by this plugin are limited to the store, order, product and picking workflow operations required by Order Picking App. Remote order creation does not create, update or delete WordPress user accounts; details for a new customer are stored on the order as guest-order data.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate SureCart.
  2. Upload and activate this plugin.
  3. Open Order Picking App in the WordPress admin.
  4. Connect or create your Order Picking App account.
  5. Configure picking, users, Product Collections, Packing and Narrowcasting as needed.

This plugin is the SureCart edition of Order Picking App.
